articles.summary: Further to its commitment to empower Indian businesses to seamlessly go global, Payments company, Cashfree Payments today announced that it has enabled Apple Pay support on international cards.
articles.title: Cashfree Payments Becomes One Of The First Indian Fintechs To Enable Apple Pay Support On International Cards; Aims To Reduce Drop-offs By Upto 75% For Indian Merchants Selling In Global Markets Like US, UAE, And EU
